title: Something showed up in the mid-2000s that changed the game

tellings.quote: I think something happened in the mid 2000s that changed the game. I think something showed up that we were not tracking.

plain: A man named Dylan Borland, who says a senior government official told him that aliens run everything, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that he believes something happened in the mid 2000s that changed the game. In his view, something showed up that the government was not tracking, which, if true, would mean a new and unexpected presence appeared around that time.
